limitations: Browser COD pickup and staff completion ran over HTTP loopback. Other sales/permission cases used HTTPS HTTP clients, with PHPUnit for concurrency. Repeat on trusted HTTPS shop devices with approved menu and services.
No off-machine monitoring, real SMTP delivery, external backup storage, supervisor or real scheduler outage has been accepted.
Worker failure was simulated by stale probe state; scheduler gap used a five-second local test threshold.
Restore elapsed time applies only to 13 small demo orders. Backup started_at is a pre-dump lower bound, not an exact transaction snapshot timestamp.
Existing cancellation restores all stock even after preparation; owner policy approval or implementation change is pending.
Daily cutoff and structured servings are not standalone fields; shop must decide requirements.
Real team members, backups, policies, product/price/allergen/address/delivery inputs remain unapproved.
Current local commit has not been pushed or run in GitHub Actions. Reviewed CI has separate SQLite/MySQL test steps and fails on skipped MySQL tests.
